features.name: SSO Login
features.description: Sign in with Google, Microsoft, GitHub, GitLab or another OIDC identity provider.

features.name: AI Connect
features.description: Connect an AI provider to review configuration files for vulnerabilities, on demand and on a schedule.

features.name: MCP Server
features.description: Read-only MCP server for AI clients (Claude Desktop, Claude Code and others), through the gateway at /mcp.

features.name: Custom Domain & HTTPS
features.description: Serve the console on your own domain with HTTPS through the built-in proxy or a load balancer.

features.name: S3 Backup Storage
features.description: Store backups in an S3-compatible bucket.

features.name: Backup & Restore
features.description: Scheduled and on-demand backups of configurations and the database, and restore.

features.name: Notifications
features.description: Notification channels and groups: email, Teams, Slack, n8n, Telegram, webhooks, SMS.

features.name: Service Accounts
features.description: Non-personal accounts with their own API keys for automation and nodes.

features.name: Multiple Workspaces
features.description: More than one workspace (Enterprise Console). The default workspace works without it.
